# `log_setting`

Area: **users** ([all tables](README.md))

The runtime log level (one row), polled every 15 s by the app, the worker and the MCP connector. Effective level: DEBUG while now < debug_until, else base_level, else the LOG_LEVEL environment value.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `boolean` | no | `true` | Always true: the table holds one row. |
| `base_level` | `text` | yes |  | WARNING or INFO; null follows the LOG_LEVEL environment value. DEBUG is never a base level. |
| `debug_until` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | DEBUG is in force until this instant (injected clock; half-open: at the instant it is over). Null or in the past: no debug. The endpoint allows at most 120 minutes ahead. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Last change by an administrator (injected clock); null until the first. |
| `updated_by` | `text` | yes |  | Username of that administrator. |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `log_setting_base_level_check` | check | `CHECK ((base_level = ANY (ARRAY['WARNING'::text, 'INFO'::text])))` |
| `log_setting_id_check` | check | `CHECK (id)` |
| `log_setting_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
